name: SMS send without currency fails before supplier
description: Records actual recording-environment behavior for an ordinary SMS request without currency: siteCurrency() is null and PhoneSupport::parse raises a 500 before the cache lock or supplier.

queries.name: sms
queries.sql: SELECT id, station_id, code, name, supplier, active, amount, settings FROM sms ORDER BY id

queries.name: sms_logs
queries.sql: SELECT id, sms_id, phone, status FROM sms_logs ORDER BY id
